name: Saibo Xincheng : Shiwu Zhaolingchu
source: Maze City: A Cyberpunk Lost and Found Centre is a game that simulates the life of a wage slave in a lost and found centre of the future cyberpunk city. Go experience life and seek the truth by chatting, returning lost items, trading and playing card games.
translation: 迷宫城：赛博朋克失物招领中心是一款模拟未来赛博朋克城市失物招领中心中工资奴隶生活的游戏。通过聊天、归还失物、交易、打牌游戏来体验生活、寻求真理。
